jobs.description: Forward Deployed AI Engineer | New York City | On-site A leading investment and financial services organisation is seeking a Forward Deployed AI Engineer to identify high-impact opportunities for AI and turn them into practical, production-ready solutions. This is a highly visible role working directly with teams across the business, including operations, finance, legal, executive support, and investment functions. The opportunity You’ll work closely with internal stakeholders to understand how work gets done, identify opportunities where AI can deliver meaningful efficiency gains, and then build solutions from idea through deployment. Key responsibilities • Partner with business teams to identify and prioritise AI opportunities • Design and build end-to-end AI workflows and applications • Translate ambiguous business processes into reliable, scalable systems • Work with modern LLMs, agents, automation, and AI tooling • Develop intuitive solutions that people genuinely want to use • Balance speed and experimentation with security, reliability, and governance • Collaborate with the wider AI and engineering teams to improve reusable capabilities • Document solutions and enable teams to operate and extend them independently What we’re looking for • Good working experience building and shipping software or data/AI products • Strong Python engineering skills • Working knowledge of TypeScript and modern frontend development • Strong product thinking and user-centred design instincts • Practical experience with modern AI/LLM tooling • Ability to operate independently in ambiguous environments • Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills Experience with AI agents, tool orchestration, evaluation frameworks, financial services, or production-grade security and reliability would be advantageous. Location: New York City Working arrangement: Fully office-based ( remote all of August) This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of AI, engineering, and high-impact business problems, with direct exposure to senior stakeholders and the ability to see your work adopted across an organisation.

jobs.description: Job Description You're ready to gain the skills and experience needed to grow within your role and advance your career — and we have the perfect software engineering opportunity for you. As a Software Engineer II at JPMorganChase within the JPMorgan Chase Asset & Wealth Management, you are part of an agile Tools Team that works to enhance, design, and deliver the software components of the firm's state-of-the-art technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. As an emerging member of a software engineering team, you execute software solutions through the design, development, and technical troubleshooting of multiple components within a technical product, application, or system, while gaining the skills and experience needed to grow within your role. Job Responsibilities Executes standard software solution, design, development, and technical troubleshooting Writes secure and high-quality code using the syntax of at least one programming language with limited guidance Leverages enterprise-authorized AI coding assist tools within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and productivity (e.g., code generation/refactoring, unit test creation, documentation), while validating outputs through peer review, automated testing, and secure coding standards. Designs, develops, codes, and troubleshoots with consideration of upstream and downstream systems and technical implications Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation Applies technical troubleshooting to breakdown solutions and solve technical problems of basic complexity Gathers, analyzes, and draws conclusions from large, diverse data sets to identify problems and contribute to decision-making in service of secure, stable application development Learns and applies system processes, methodologies, and skills for the development of secure, stable code and systems Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 2+ years applied experience Hands-on full stack development having experience utilizing: Java and/or Python JavaScript/NodeJS Experience in UX/UI design, building modern, user-centered interfaces and adhering to UI standards, and accessibility. Hands-on practical experience in system design, application development, testing, and operational stability Experience in developing, debugging, and maintaining code in a large corporate environment with one or more modern programming languages and database querying languages Hands-on experience using enterprise-authorized AI-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e.g., for coding, testing, troubleshooting, or documentation) with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate and validate AI-generated outputs. Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations. Experience across the whole Software Development Life Cycle Exposure to agile methodologies such as CI/CD, Application Resiliency, and Security Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills Working knowledge of AWS Cloud services and Cloud Foundry platforms. Hands-on with automation tools such as Playwright and Cucumber Familiarity with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI) ABOUT US JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management. We offer a competitive total rewards package including base salary determined based on the role, experience, skill set and location. Those in eligible roles may receive commission-based pay and/or discretionary incentive compensation, paid in the form of cash and/or forfeitable equity, awarded in recognition of individual achievements and contributions. We also offer a range of benefits and programs to meet employee needs, based on eligibility. These benefits include comprehensive health care coverage, on-site health and wellness centers, a retirement savings plan, backup childcare, tuition reimbursement, mental health support, financial coaching and more. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided during the hiring process. We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. jobs.description: Our client is a high-growth, early-stage company building production-grade AI and agentic technology . The company is hiring multiple exceptional Forward Deployed AI Engineers / Software Engineers in San Francisco. These positions sit at the intersection of software engineering, applied AI, product and enterprise customers . Engineers will build core product functionality and production systems while working directly with customers to understand complex workflows, develop solutions and own deployments end-to-end. This is not a traditional solutions consulting role . The company wants strong software engineers who enjoy being customer-facing, not customer-facing professionals who only do light coding. Depending on your background, you may lean more heavily toward forward-deployed customer work or core backend/infrastructure engineering. In either case, you'll be expected to build production software and operate with significant autonomy. What You'll Do Build and ship production-grade AI, backend and full-stack systems Develop APIs, integrations, automations and AI-enabled workflows Build and deploy AI agents and agentic systems Work directly with enterprise customers to understand complex business and technical requirements Own projects from initial customer requirements through architecture, development and deployment Translate customer problems into scalable technical solutions Rapidly prototype new functionality and convert successful prototypes into production systems Own significant components of the product and infrastructure Work closely with founders and senior engineers on technical and product decisions Troubleshoot complex technical issues directly with customers Help drive customer implementations, adoption and expansion Use modern AI development tools to increase engineering velocity Travel periodically to customer sites depending on the position Ideal Candidate We're looking for an exceptional software engineer who wants more ownership and customer exposure than a traditional engineering role provides . You may currently be a: Forward Deployed Engineer Backend Engineer Full-Stack Engineer Founding Engineer Applied AI Engineer Infrastructure Engineer Early-stage startup engineer Technical founder The common denominator is strong software engineering ability combined with the communication skills and commercial curiosity to work directly with customers. Requirements 2–6 years of professional software engineering experience Ideally 3–5 years of experience, including customer-facing engineering exposure Strong Python, Java and/or TypeScript Strong backend and/or full-stack engineering capabilities Experience building APIs, integrations and production systems Ability to independently own projects from requirements through deployment Strong technical problem-solving ability Excellent communication skills Comfortable interacting directly with both senior business leaders and engineers High attention to detail and strong work ethic High degree of autonomy and ownership Strong user of modern AI development tools such as Claude, Cursor, Codex or similar Interest in AI, FinTech, HealthTech, Government or other complex regulated industries Must be San Francisco-based or willing to relocate Comfortable working in office 5 days/week Highly Desirable Backgrounds We're particularly interested in candidates with experience as: Palantir Forward Deployed Engineers Applied engineers from leading AI and AI-agent companies Early engineers at high-growth FinTech and HealthTech companies Engineers from fast-moving Series A–C startups Successful former founders or founding engineers YC founders or early YC startup engineers Big Tech engineers with strong zero-to-one or startup experience Experience with companies or environments similar to Palantir, Sierra, Decagon, Glean, OpenAI, Anthropic, Ramp, Mercury, Brex or Slope is highly relevant. Strong Plus Previous startup founder or founding engineer experience Production experience with LLMs, AI agents, agent orchestration or applied AI Consumer lending, commercial lending, mortgage or FinTech experience Document AI, OCR or computer vision experience Voice AI or telephony experience Experience building software in regulated or compliance-heavy industries Zero-to-one product development experience Experience working directly with enterprise customers Exceptional technical achievement, including competitive programming, Math Olympiad, ICPC/IOI or similar accomplishments Who Will Thrive This role is designed for engineers who want to build, own and deploy , rather than work on a narrowly defined piece of a large engineering organization. You'll thrive if you enjoy taking an ambiguous customer or product problem, determining what needs to be built, and then shipping the solution. You should be comfortable moving between customer conversations, architecture decisions and hands-on coding. The strongest candidates combine the technical depth of a software engineer with the ownership, speed and communication skills of a startup founder. Please note: This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. This is an opportunity to join an ambitious early-stage AI company, work directly with founders and enterprise customers, and help build the next generation of AI infrastructure for FinTech and lending .
